description: Application-owned zero-network processing of one fixed local Mississippi Business Reports package into an operation-scoped local-review release.
redirect_policy: No network requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; inspect the durable terminal receipt and explicitly correct or replace the local package.
checkpoint: A UUID operation owns its immutable input snapshot, manifest-last local-review release, start record, and terminal receipt.
idempotency: Independent verification replays the fixed input snapshot and requires exact normalized output bytes and hashes.
cancellation: Cooperative cancellation removes only the operation-owned snapshot and unpublished release, then writes CANCELLED.
retention_profile: Operation evidence remains local-review-only; no pointer, admission, completeness, current-operation, geocode, site, or public-export claim is made.
